blocks.text: All Dressed Up is a 1918 silent film short produced and directed by Al Christie. It starred Betty Compson. It is currently considered a lost film.
"All Dressed Up" is a song by English media personality Lauren Harries. It was written and produced by Edward Russell and was released by Erlectro Music on 1 May 2015.

Dress-up is a children's game in which costumes or clothing are put on a person or on a doll, for role-playing or aesthetics purposes. In the UK the game is called dressing up. In the mid-1990s, dress-up games also became a video game genre in which customizing a virtual character's appearance is the primary focus.
All-dressed is a potato chip flavour popular in Canada. It is a combination of ketchup, BBQ, sour cream and onion, and salt and vinegar.
